name: Rebrand to 주주의관제탑
objective: Replace the product's user-facing identity — name 미주알 → 주주의관제탑 (uniformly unspaced, no latin mark) and the MIJUAL wordmark → the operator's supplied logo plus a derived white variant for the cosmos-dark chrome — across every operator-visible surface: brand binaries, favicon, document title, chrome and ops copy, the signed Korean strings that name the product, and user-visible docs. Code identifiers (src/mijual, MIJUAL_* env vars, X-Mijual-CSRF) are explicitly out of scope. Lands before P4 so the deck, demo video and submission carry the new name.

acceptance.walkthrough:
P10 수용 확인 — 리브랜드 (주주의관제탑).

0. 스택부터. `make stack-up` DOES NOT WORK right now — `db-up` fails because host port 5433 is held
   by your own `changple_web_dev_postgres`. Do not stop that container. Run this instead (nothing
   enters the repo; the `!override` tag is load-bearing — a plain override merges port lists and
   still tries 5433):

     printf 'services:\n  postgres:\n    ports: !override\n      - "5434:5432"\n' > /tmp/c5434.yaml
     docker compose -f compose.yaml -f /tmp/c5434.yaml up -d --force-recreate postgres
     DATABASE_URL='postgresql+psycopg://mijual:mijual@localhost:5434/mijual' \
       MIJUAL_OPS_ID=<any> MIJUAL_OPS_PASSWORD=<any> <the Makefile's db-ensure then api-up bodies>
     make web-up && make stack-status          # → http://127.0.0.1:3000

   Same image, same `mijual_mijual-pgdata` volume — no data moves. Restore afterwards with
   `make stack-down` then
   `docker compose -f compose.yaml up --no-start --force-recreate postgres`.
   Also: `MIJUAL_OPS_ID` / `MIJUAL_OPS_PASSWORD` are unset in `.env`, so without the two throwaway
   values above `/ops` will only ever show you the door, never the bar. The whole recipe with real
   command bodies is `works/phases/active/P10/slices/P10.S5/result.md` §0.

   What is NOT being asked of you: re-testing the sweep. 36 page-views in dev and in a production
   build, at 1280 and 390, were checked by S5 and re-checked by me — marks painted, both titles,
   the 실권주 line, `/docs`, the retired assets 404, no old name on any reader page, the live agent
   naming itself correctly. What is wanted is your judgement on three design questions, and your
   eye on the mark itself.

A. 마크. Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ and look at the top-left, then scroll to the footer.
   The 주주의관제탑 wordmark with its sparkle cluster is there, white on the cosmos dark, clean at
   retina (no colour cast, no halo — measured).

   Q1 — 크기. THE DECISION. The nav mark is `h19`, the footer `h17`, exactly as signed. Measured:
   the Korean glyph band is 9.65px (nav) and 8.63px (footer) against a 13.5px nav label and a 12px
   footer line — the brand is **0.72×** the type beside it, where the retired ring was **1.07×**.
   Look at the footer especially: the name is set twice in that row, and the typed 「© 주주의관제탑」
   is the bigger, more legible of the two. Nothing breaks — the slot narrowed 119.6 → 72.24px, the
   24px gap is unchanged, nothing wraps at 1280 or 390.
   Recommendation, acceptable in one word: **`h27` nav / `h24` footer** — band 13.71 / 12.19px,
   parity with the adjacent type, boxes still narrower than the old ring's.
   Before/after crops: `var/p10s5/dev-nav-h19-signed.png` vs `dev-nav-h27-simulated.png`, and
   `dev-footer-h17-signed.png` vs `dev-footer-h24-simulated.png`.
   → say "h27/h24" to take it, or "keep h19/h17". It is your signed number, so nobody moved it.

B. 운영 마크. Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ops and log in with the throwaway credentials.
   The door and the bar both read 「주주의관제탑 운영」.

   Q2 — 서체. THE DECISION. `Ops.module.css` was left untouched, so `.mark` still carries
   `--font-mono` + `letter-spacing: 0.08em` from R7's "an identifier, so it stays raw and mono".
   With a Korean string that rule now styles **one character out of nine** — the space. Chrome
   reports IBM Plex Mono for **1 glyph** and the OS Korean face (Apple SD Gothic Neo) for the other
   **8**. Three visible consequences: the 관제탑␣운영 gap is 2.84× a normal Korean space and reads
   as a double space (`var/p10s5/prod-ops-mark-zoom.png`, 6×); the mark's face is the **OS's**, so
   it will look different anywhere but macOS; and in the bar it now sits in the same face as the
   tab labels 개요 · 게이트 대기열 · … while the `mijual:lock:pipeline` chip beside it is still
   unmistakably mono — so the chip reads as an identifier and the mark no longer does
   (`var/p10s5/prod-desktop-ops-bar.png`).
   Recommendation, acceptable in one word: **drop `--font-mono` and the tracking from `.mark` and
   `.doorMark`, let Pretendard 600 carry it.** The string itself does not change.
   → say "drop mono" to take it, or "keep it as signed".

C. 파비콘. THE DECISION, and the reason nothing shipped. At 32px the mark is illegible mush, and
   the assets README forbids a slice substituting, generating or placeholding an image. So P10
   shipped **nothing** and cropped nothing: no `app/icon.*`, no `favicon.ico`, no manifest, no
   `openGraph`, and zero `link[rel*=icon]` in dev or production — verified, not assumed. Your tab
   therefore shows the browser's default globe.
   → (a) ship no favicon, as today · (b) you supply a square symbol export · (c) you authorize
   cropping the sparkle cluster as a symbol.

D. 이름, 세 화면만. Everything else was swept; these three are worth 10 seconds each because they
   are where the name is *said* rather than drawn:
   - http://127.0.0.1:3000/ask → type 「이 서비스 이름이 뭐야?」. The assistant answers
     「…주주의관제탑…」. The prompt used to spell the product 미주얼 — a third spelling nobody knew
     about — so this is the one that could not be caught by grep.
   - http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs → the Swagger page title reads 「주주의관제탑 API」.
   - http://127.0.0.1:3000/events/20260223002079 → the red 「발행사 기재 불일치」 box says
     「…주주의관제탑은 어느 쪽도 고르지 않고 둘 다 보여드립니다」. One line, same box as before.

E. 그리고 안 물어보는 것들 — so nothing surprises you while you walk it:
   - **`/ops` at 390px stacks one syllable per line** — the mark AND all six tab labels. The bar has
     no phone layout and never had one; P10's Korean string made the mark worse, but the defect is
     pre-existing and wider than the mark. Filed as a deferred job, not fixed, because the two
     available fixes differ in scope. The `/ops` **door** at 390 is fine.
   - **`make stack-status` prints `── mijual dev stack ───`** and `/ops` shows
     `mijual:lock:pipeline`. Deliberate: identifiers, the repo directory, `MIJUAL_*`, `X-Mijual-CSRF`
     and both package `name` fields are all out of scope by your own decision, and renaming three
     Makefile banners while leaving the container name and the lock key would make that terminal
     less consistent, not more. Filed as a deferred job.
   - **P4's mail subject still says `[미주알]`.** The signed R5 spec quoted at `src/mijual/mail.py:14`
     is unimplemented, so nothing sends it today — but P4 will, unless you re-sign the subject.
     Filed as a deferred job so it reaches P4.

F. 통과시키려면: `python3 scripts/workflow.py accept-gate P10 --clear --note "..."`.
   문제가 있으면: report it and it is recorded as `changes_requested` — that is never refused.
